courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的鐵道與交通設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring railway and transport systems through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 鐵路平交道警報聯動
related.transfer: 可遷移「停準接近軌跡」與「旅客交換與門週期」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；鐵路平交道警報聯動的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Precision-stop approach trajectory" and "Passenger exchange and door cycle" transfer, while operating boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Railway grade-crossing warning coordination must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦停車位置門控時序與月台介面誤差預算；鐵路平交道警報聯動則以平交道警示時序道路清空與界面整合為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on stopping position door timing and platform-interface error budgets; Railway grade-crossing warning coordination centres on crossing-warning timing road clearance and interface integration, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「停準接近軌跡」與「道路使用者反應距離」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到鐵路平交道警報聯動，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「區段偵測有效性」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Precision-stop approach trajectory” and “Road-user reaction distance”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Railway grade-crossing warning coordination, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Validity of section detection", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 月台門列車停準整合
history.text: 本課以可查核的工程與方法出版歷程建立背景：1991 年一九八五年緊急整備指南於該年重印。；2015 年地下車站旅客流研究報告於該年出版。；2025 年臺灣鐵道車站概念設計指引函頒。這些日期分別是工程事件、指南重印或標準研究出版，並非宣稱本課系統在該年問世。對停車位置門控時序與月台介面誤差預算而言，歷史脈絡的價值是理解需求如何從單一設備擴展到跨介面證據。本課再用停準資訊有效時間及異車型門位配對連結這些方法；代表工程僅提供觀察方向，假想參數不冒充現場資料，歷史版規範也不自動等於當地現行要求。
history.textEn: The background uses checkable project events and methodological publication history. 1991: The rail-transit emergency guide originally published in nineteen eighty-five was reprinted. 2015: A study of underground-station passenger flow was published. 2025: Taiwan issued guidance for conceptual railway-station design. These dates identify project events, guide reprints, or standards and research publications, rather than claiming that the lesson system first appeared then. For stopping position door timing and platform-interface error budgets, the useful historical perspective is the expansion from individual equipment to evidence across interfaces. The course connects that perspective through freshness of stopping information and door-position mapping across fleets. Reference projects guide observation only: hypothetical parameters are not field data, and historical editions do not automatically establish current local requirements.
